description.value: Oceanfront Suites at Cowichan Bay is an all-suite waterfront hotel perched in the seaside village of Cowichan Bay with panoramic views of the bay and Mount Tzouhalem. The property offers spacious one- and two-bedroom suites with full kitchens, an indoor heated pool, hot tub, sauna, and fitness centre. An on-site restaurant, The Cook and Butcher by Cow Cafe, and 24-hour guest services make it a comfortable base for exploring the Cowichan Valley's wine and cycling routes.

address.value: 1681 Cowichan Bay Rd Cowichan Bay BC V0R 1N0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity information. Suite amenities explicitly list 'Free WiFi' and there is an on-site restaurant (The Cook and Butcher by Cow Cafe) serving dinner Tuesday–Sunday, confirming evening food. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, or any cyclist-specific infrastructure appears anywhere on the site. Contact details on the website (address, phone) are consistent with the OSM record's URL but OSM carries no phone or address fields to cross-check against.
concerns: OSM record has no OSM ID, no address, no phone, and no tags — it is a manually added entry with minimal OSM data.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating waterfront all-suite hotel in Cowichan Bay with an active website, current offers, and on-site dining — clearly useful to touring cyclists on the Vancouver Crossing Loop.
